content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Dayton

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—typically a secondary degree plus years of directed project work, or an advanced degree with less experience. Gather your documentation before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Our instructors deliver the full 35-hour curriculum required by PMI through interactive online sessions you can join from anywhere. Attend all sessions, participate actively, and receive your course completion certificate.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, create your PMI account and formally apply for PMP certification eligibility. Upload your education and experience documentation, agree to PMI's Code of Conduct, and pay the examination fee directly to PMI. Allow time for PMI to review and approve your application.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and Q&A support—to build confidence. Schedule your PMP exam through Pearson VUE at a testing center or online proctored session. Sit for the computer-based exam and receive your pass/fail results immediately upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP credential is valid for three years. Maintain your certification by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, PMI membership activities, and project-management practice. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your competitive advantage in Dayton's job market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
